assets.title: Афиша «Кот детектив»
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Premium portrait 2:3 film poster for a dark serious stylized ANIMATED Victorian animal noir. Preserve the exact original cat identity and costume from image1 and exact dog from image2: green-eyed white-cheeked grey/brown tabby detective in brown tweed deerstalker/cape, taller anxious brown dark-muzzled constable in navy bobby coat and helmet. Painterly textured dimensional animation matching source, cinematic ink shadows, NOT live-action and not generic children's cartoon. Large calm cat face and magnifying glass foreground left, worried dog with gas lantern slightly behind right. Wet London street recedes into immense blue-black fog, gaslamps, clock tower and thin red thread connecting abstract evidence in composition. Unknown shadow on distant bridge must be unmistakably an anthropomorphic animal but face/species hidden; no human silhouettes or human portraits anywhere. Warm amber lantern, desaturated petrol shadows, brass glints, sophisticated mystery poster hierarchy. Large beautifully typeset exact Cyrillic title at bottom in two lines: "КОТ" / "ДЕТЕКТИВ". Ivory engraved Victorian serif lettering, crisp readable, balanced spacing, small red wax seal detail beneath. ONLY those title words; no tagline, credits, English, or subtitles. Keep faces unobstructed, title not on faces, no watermark, no parody, no food.
